Question1:
1)Inverted Right-Angled Triangle
For n = 5:
*****
****
***
**
*

Code:
package dailyAssignment;

public class Program_InvertedrightangleTriangle {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		for(int rows=1;rows<=5;rows++)
		{
			for(int col=1;col<=5-rows+1;col++)
			{
				System.out.print("*");
			}
			System.out.println();
		}

	}

}

Output:
*****
****
***
**
*

Question2:

2)Increasing Number Triangle
For n = 5:
1
12
123
1234
12345

Code:
package dailyAssignment;

public class Program_IncresingNumberTriangle {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		int count=1;
		for(int rows=1;rows<=5;rows++)
		{
			for(int i=1;i<=rows;i++)
			{
				
				System.out.print(i);
				//count++;
			}
			System.out.println();
		}

	}

}

Output:
1
12
123
1234
12345

Question3:
3)Repeated Number Triangle
1
22
333
4444
55555

Code:
package dailyAssignment;

public class Program_RepeatedNumberTriangle {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		int count=1;
		for(int rows=1;rows<=5;rows++)
		{
			for(int i=1;i<=rows;i++)
			{
				
				System.out.print(rows);
				
			}
			System.out.println();
		}

	}

}

Output:
1
22
333
4444
55555

Question4:

4)Butterfly Pattern
For n = 5:
*        *
**      **
***    ***
****  ****
**********
****  ****
***    ***
**      **
*        *



Code:
package dailyAssignment;

public class Program_butterflyPattern {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		for(int row=1;row<=5;row++)
		{
			for(int star=1;star<=row;star++)
				System.out.print("*");
		
		    for(int sp=1;sp<=10-2*row;sp++)
			 System.out.print(" ");
		    
		    for(int star=1;star<=row;star++)
				System.out.print("*");
		    System.out.println();
		}   
       for(int row=1;row<=4;row++)
       {
    	   for(int star=1;star<=5-row;star++)
    		   System.out.print("*");
    	   
    	   for(int sp=1;sp<=2*row;sp++)
    		   System.out.print(" ");
    	   
    	   for(int star=1;star<=5-row;star++)
    		   System.out.print("*");
    	   System.out.println();
       }
	}

}


output:
**      **
***    ***
****  ****
**********
****  ****
***    ***
**      **
*        *
